content: The status of Crimea is a matter of international dispute. Russia annexed Crimea in 2014, but this is not recognized by most countries, including Ukraine, which continues to claim it as part of its territory. The United Nations General Assembly has adopted several resolutions affirming the territorial integrity of Ukraine, including Crimea. However, Russia and a few other countries recognize Crimea as part of the Russian Federation. The issue remains unresolved, and different entities and international bodies have differing positions on who has the right to govern the region.
